responsibility: Declares the M2Dependent interface that allows boot runtime modules to register themselves with names, library names, init/fini callbacks, and dependency descriptors, and provides entry points to construct and deconstruct the ordered module set. This header defines the dependency-resolution contract used by M2RTS to drive runtime module initialization sequencing.
same_name_distinction: This is the public API file for the GM2Dependent pair: it declares the callback type and dependency-management entry points used by the runtime, while GM2Dependent.cc contains the internal module records, state lists, ordering logic, and constructor/destructor execution.
